articulation.label: this
articulation.alt: this: /ð/ → /ɪ/ → /s/. Tongue, lips, contact and airflow positions.
notes: /ð/: Tongue tip at the teeth; add voice.
/ɪ/: Front tongue, a little lower and relaxed.
/s/: Make a narrow gap near the ridge; let air flow.
articulation.note: Join the sounds smoothly after practising each position.

cards.title: Five words to hear and use
sections: used before a noun to point to one thing near you. This book is red.
used before a noun to point to one thing farther away. That bag is blue.
the people or things already mentioned. They are at home.
The object form of they, used for people or things already mentioned. I have two books. Please take them.
Belonging to the people or things already mentioned. The children have their books.
